How the numbers are defined. Views are counted to date on clips that met the campaign rules, posted in the period shown, so a period keeps adding views after it ends. Clips out counts every clip posted. Cost per 1,000 views is $15,000 a month divided by those views. The headline uses the last 30 days. In the total since June the current month is counted by the day; a month's own cost per 1,000 appears once the month has closed.

How we count

Changes to how views are counted, by date.

Oct 12: the last 30 days were 11.7M views, $1.28 per 1,000 views (the figure Sean shared).

Oct 19: views on clips that did not meet the campaign rules stopped counting. This is stricter, so earlier totals dropped (lifetime 62.7M to 46.9M).

Nov 7: every LLTV post on our own pages now counts, including posts booked outside our engine that were missed before. Added views: 675,659 on clips posted Oct 7 to Nov 5.

This sheet and the client dashboard come from the same data and are checked against each other on every update.

How campaigns run

Each show's clipping campaign opens the day a new episode drops and runs until it is used up. A week with no new episode has no campaign for that show, so a quiet week there is by design.
